none.$description: No rounding — full-bleed elements, edge-to-edge banners, explicitly sharp components. | ai-group:roundness

xsmall.$description: Barely rounded — for very subtle softening, almost-sharp aesthetic. | ai-group:roundness

small.$description: Slight rounding — default for interactive controls (buttons, inputs) in the default personality. | ai-group:roundness

medium.$description: Moderate rounding — default for cards and container surfaces. | ai-group:roundness

large.$description: Prominent rounding — modals, popovers, overlays in default personality. | ai-group:roundness

xlarge.$description: Strong rounding — interactive controls in rounded personality, container surfaces in bubbly. | ai-group:roundness

2xlarge.$description: Very strong rounding — used in bubbly/expressive personality modes. | ai-group:roundness

full.$description: Fully circular/pill — chips, badges, avatar images, toggle switches. | ai-group:roundness

hairline.$description: Hairline border — structural dividers between list rows, table cells. Barely perceptible by design. | ai-group:weight

thin.$description: Standard border width — interactive form elements at rest: inputs, selects, card outlines. Universal default. | ai-group:weight

medium.$description: Medium border — slightly more prominent outlines, active states where extra visibility is needed. | ai-group:weight

bold.$description: Bold border — focus rings, active input borders, strong emphasis outlines. | ai-group:weight

width.$description: Minimum width per WCAG 2.4.11 accessibility requirement. Never reduce below this value.

offset.$description: Gap between focused element edge and focus ring. Creates clear visual separation between focused element and its ring. | ai-group:locked | ai-locked:true
